title: Comfy Gateway API Contract Boundary
description: Explicit transport, authentication, and endpoint contracts for the Comfy Gateway runtime in isolate and baseline. Enforced by tests/test_api_contract_conformance.py, which drives the real routes and fails in BOTH directions: a declared field the response omits, and a response field this file does not declare. Editing an endpoint without editing this file is meant to turn the suite red.

transport.default_port_note: The kernel's DEFAULT_PORT and the port the container listens on. Host publish ports are a deployment choice and are NOT protocol defaults: baseline's companion dev-mcp publishes 8721, isolate's lab gateway publishes 8722. Version 1.0.0 of this file wrongly declared 8721 as the transport default.

endpoints.description: Authenticated runtime provenance attestation. A loopback URL and a healthy response do not identify a project; this does. Note that source_root is /workspace inside any container built from network/mcp/Dockerfile, so `project` is the only field that names the owning repository.

MCP tool invocation and streaming endpoint. No response schema is declared: the payload is JSON-RPC over a streamable-http session owned by FastMCP, not a shape this repository defines. Conformance for this route is the transport auth contract above, not a body schema.
